name: indent-guide
author: lumine-code
description: Indentation guides with active scope highlighting.
backgroundTips: The indentation guides enclosing the cursor are highlighted, so you always see which block you are in.

cursorAwareActive.title: Cursor Aware Active
cursorAwareActive.description: When enabled, the active guide is determined by the cursor column position. When disabled, the deepest guide on the cursor line is always marked active.
